method.memory: process private bytes, ~1 ms samples during background wait
method.concurrency: independent service test processes sharing one temporary store; barrier before measure commands; observed Python send spread is not native dispatch skew
method.aggregate_memory: sum of private bytes per sequential process sweep, requested 5 ms sampling interval; records sample count and maximum sweep duration; excludes controller and file cache; not a strict or atomic peak
method.group_wall: barrier release through all measure responses, including cleanup wait and pipe overhead; excludes publication and candidate validation
method.cache: uncontrolled warm cache: snapshots copied and hashed before each publication
method.background: wall wait after dispatch, includes scheduling/sampling; not pure worker CPU time
method.apply: production pollDictionaries on owner thread; includes synchronous cleanup before optimization or cleanup dispatch after optimization, plus runtime status
method.cleanup: when supported, wait for detached cleanup after timing apply; private_settled sampled afterwards
method.limits: no TSF host insertion/rendering; peak is sampled lower bound; apply peak not continuously sampled; two versions share data bytes
